content.short: Sherpa is a delta-neutral USDC vault issuing shUSD shares routed through quantitative strategies.
content.description: Sherpa takes USDC deposits into delta-neutral strategies and issues shUSD representing a share of the vault, so holders are exposed to the strategy's return rather than to market direction. Delta-neutral yield holds up well while funding is positive, and the honest question for any such vault is what it does when funding inverts.
content.meta: USDC deposits into delta-neutral strategies, issued as shUSD shares.
